bio.text: Bernard "Berney" Flowers is the Republican nominee for Maryland's 3rd Congressional District in 2026, having advanced from the June 23 primary; he faces Rep. Sarah Elfreth in the general election.
He was born in Lumberton, North Carolina, and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1987 to 2008.

He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Pembroke in 1987 and a graduate degree from Golden Gate University in 1991, and his career includes cybersecurity work for the federal government.
